question: Government Announces Formation of Higher Education Commission of India. Which of the following is NOT it's four specialized verticals?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**National Assets Depository Limited (NSDL)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Government Announces Formation of Higher Education Commission of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Formation of Higher Education Commission of India** to replace UGC, AICTE, and NCTE.

 
 
• 
 
Aim to create a **globally competitive**, **innovation-driven** higher education system.

 
 
• 
 
**Unified** and **transparent** regulation with a **tech-driven** approach.

 
 
• 
 
Shift from **input-based** to **outcome-based** governance.

 
 
• 
 
Foster **institutional autonomy** with **rigorous accountability**.

 
 
• 
 
**Technology integration**: Use of **AI**, **blockchain**, and **predictive analytics** for quality assurance.

 
 
• 
 
Position India as a **global education hub by 2030**.

 
 
• 
 
HECI will operate through four specialized verticals:

 
 
• 
 
**National Higher Education Regulatory Council (NHERC)**: Unified approval and **real-time monitoring**.

 
 
• 
 
**National Accreditation Council (NAC)**: Focus on **outcome-based quality assurance**.

 
 
• 
 
**Higher Education Grants Council (HEGC)**: **Performance-linked funding** for innovation and research excellence.

 
 
• 
 
**General Education Council (GEC)**: **Curriculum modernisation** for global compatibility.
